S6 IMPLEMENTATION PLAN COMPLETE.

**Approach**: P1 — Shared bash library plugins/dso/scripts/lib/worktree-removal-guards.sh (matches existing lib/ convention). Score 21/25 vs P2 inline-duplication 12/25 (DRY violation on safety-critical guards) vs P3 Python shell-out 9/25 (over-engineering).

**Story description correction**: claude-safe is a STANDALONE SCRIPT at plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe — NOT inside agent-batch-lifecycle.sh as the story says.

**Tasks (7)**:
- T1 (406b) RED unit tests for guard library (3 guards + sub-PR enumeration via --head AND --base + gh unavailability + path safety) [no deps]
- T2 (1018) IMPL library: 4 functions + fail-closed gh contract + sanctioned override (WORKTREE_REMOVAL_SKIP_PR_CHECK + REASON) [depends T1]
- T3 (f809) UPDATE claude-safe: double-check TOCTOU + flock -n concurrent lock + bypass propagation [depends T2]
- T4 (e75b) UPDATE harvest-worktree.sh: single-check rationale + --force bypass propagation contract [depends T2, T7]
- T5 (4d98) RED E2E test test-worktree-removal-guards-e2e.sh (renamed) — 2 sub-PRs via --base [depends T3]
- T6 (7e83) DOC WORKTREE-GUIDE.md (override env var + force semantics + 3-tier enumeration) [depends T4]
- T7 (NEW) RED test for harvest-worktree.sh guards integration [depends T2; T4 depends_on T7]

**Plan-Review**: 5 findings (1 critical, 2 major, 2 minor) — applied as AC amendments to T1, T2, T3, T4, T5.
**Gap-Analysis**: 8 findings — 7 AC amendments + 1 NEW task (T7 dedicated harvest-worktree RED test).

**Critical structural fix**: Tier 1 (gh pr list --head <session>) does NOT capture sub-PRs (heads are sub-branches). Required enumeration uses BOTH --head AND --base to find sub-PRs whose BASE is the session branch.
